title: Exploration of antiproliferative potential of modified triazole-benzohydrazone scaffold: Multitarget approach.
authors: Ali, Alaa M; Khalaf, Mohamed A; Bhongade, Bhoomendra A; Selim, Khalid B; Mostafa, Amany S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三唑-苯甲酰肼衍生物的抗增殖活性与多激酶抑制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-激酶，仅排除DNA结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A novel series of triazole-benzohydrazone hybrids was efficiently designed and synthesized as antiproliferative agents, targeting different kinases. All compounds were screened via the National Cancer Institute (NCI) against 60 cancer cell lines, where compounds 16, 17, and 18 exhibited growth inhibition percent (GI%) of various leukemia subpanels with values of 70.33%, 64.13%, and 76.03%, respectively. Compound 18 showed broad-spectrum antiproliferative efficacy toward most cancer cells, with outstanding potency regarding melanoma (MALME-3M GI% = 101.82%) and breast cancer cell lines (MCF7 GI% = 85.87%), while proving safe toward the WI-38 normal cell line, compared to doxorubicin. Multikinase investigation including vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2 (VEGFR-2), mesenchymal epithelial transition factor (c-Met), proto-oncogene B-Raf, mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase, extracellular signal-regulated kinase, and phosphoinositide 3-kinase was accomplished to reveal its plausible mechanism of action, giving the ultimate potency against both VEGFR-2 and c-Met with IC(50) values of 0.055 and 0.042 muM, respectively, while displaying moderate to good inhibition concerning the remaining kinases. DNA binding capability was excluded using the methyl green colorimetric assay. Further, it exhibited both early and late apoptotic induction by about 16- and 9.4-fold over the control, respectively, triggering cell cycle arrest in the G2/M phase. Physicochemical properties and bioavailability radar plot inferred drug-likeness characteristics for compound 18. The molecular docking study assessed the binding pattern with the active sites of c-Met and VEGFR-2.
abstract_zh: 设计并高效合成了一系列新型三唑-苯甲酰肼杂合体，作为靶向不同激酶的抗增殖剂。所有化合物均通过美国国家癌症研究所（NCI）对60种癌细胞系进行了筛选，其中化合物16、17和18对多种白血病亚组的生长抑制百分比（GI%）分别为70.33%、64.13%和76.03%。化合物18对大多数癌细胞表现出广谱抗增殖效力，尤其在黑色素瘤（MALME-3M GI% = 101.82%）和乳腺癌细胞系（MCF7 GI% = 85.87%）方面具有显著活性，同时与多柔比星相比，对WI-38正常细胞系显示出安全性。进行了多激酶研究，包括血管内皮生长因子受体2（VEGFR-2）、间质上皮转化因子（c-Met）、原癌基因B-Raf、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶激酶、细胞外信号调节激酶和磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶，以揭示其可能的作用机制，结果显示其对VEGFR-2和c-Met具有最强效力，IC(50)值分别为0.055和0.042 μM，而对其他激酶表现出中度至良好的抑制作用。通过甲基绿比色法排除了DNA结合能力。此外，它诱导早期和晚期凋亡，分别约为对照组的16倍和9.4倍，并触发细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期。理化性质和生物利用度雷达图推断化合物18具有类药特性。分子对接研究评估了其与c-Met和VEGFR-2活性位点的结合模式。
